name: Hilary's Necklace
summary: In Lakeshire, Hilary searches for the necklace she lost in Lake Everstill. Her father gave it to her when she was young, and it slipped beneath the water while she and the other children fished by the docks.

sections.title: Lost in the Depths
sections.body: Hilary lost her necklace while fishing with her friend Shawn along the Lakeshire shore. Her father had given it to her, and she treasures the gift. Fierce beasts and aggressive murlocs live in the lake's depths, so local children stay on the docks. The necklace remains beneath the water, buried in the lakebed silt.

faq.q: Who does this necklace belong to?
faq.answer: The necklace belongs to Hilary, a young girl who lives in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Her father gave it to her.

faq.q: How did the necklace end up in Lake Everstill?
aliases: how did it get in the lake
faq.answer: Hilary was fishing by the water with Shawn when the necklace slipped off and sank into Lake Everstill.

faq.q: Why didn't the children dive in to get it back?
aliases: why didn't nida swim for it
why can't shawn get the necklace
why didn't hilary swim for it
faq.answer: Their parents forbid the children to swim in Lake Everstill. Dangerous predators and aggressive murlocs live in its deep waters and threaten the townspeople.
Effsee is Hilary's pet cat. The cat stays by her side in Lakeshire and welcomes the necklace's return with its young owner.

angles.text: Lakeshire's defenders face threats from the surrounding area. Traveling Alliance adventurers can help local children recover lost keepsakes.
